title: sigexport Message
description: One JSON object per line in sigexport's data.json (NDJSON). Field names follow Message.dict() in carderne/signal-export. Reactions are [name, emoji] pairs because Reaction is a namedtuple. sticker is null when the message has no sticker; a schema inferred from a single sticker-less message often types that field as null only. missing_kind is null when the file was copied, or a short string ("media", "attachment") when the attachment existed but was not exported.

date.description: datetime.isoformat(), naive local time from the Signal database.

body.description: Message text. sigexport appends two spaces so Markdown keeps the line break. Call messages use a phrase like "Incoming voice call (accepted, 3m 12s)" or "Missed video call".

quote.description:
Empty when this is not a reply. Otherwise a Markdown blockquote: "

> quoted text

". Replies to media with no text use Photo, Video, Voice message, or Attachment.

reactions.description: Each item is [reactor name, emoji], in the order sigexport stored them.

path.description: Relative path. Spaces are percent-encoded (%20), matching Path substitution in sigexport.

missing_kind.description: null if the file was exported. "media" or "attachment" if it was left out.

missed.description: True when a call was missed, unanswered, or declined.
